topic: Mixamo LLM Mocap: Turn Any Video into a Rigged Animation via AI Agent

key_points: Open-source pipeline (204 stars, 44 forks) that turns any locked-camera video into a clean FK animation on any Mixamo character, operated end-to-end by an AI agent

10-stage pipeline: GVHMR SMPL-X mesh recovery -> landmark analysis -> JSON action spec -> direction-preserving retarget -> FK apply in Blender via Blender MCP -> automated QA gate -> frame-by-frame comparison -> render preview
Motions are data, not code: a new motion is a small JSON spec (action_specs) with support schedule, rest blends, fists
Honest Mixamo FK: hips are the only translating bone, everything else quaternions at 30fps; planted feet solve to ground height with zero skate
QA gate catches exploded bones, hip pops, foot skate, drifting roots numerically before a human looks
Closed refinement loop: compare_reference.py measures retarget vs source video frame-by-frame (hand height, distance between hands, limb intrusion, gaze)
Two-character support: splits a two-performer plate by screen side, retargets onto two different Mixamo characters, checks mesh-vs-mesh collision
Written for agents: beat decisions from numbers, every stage a CLI or socket call, docs/PITFALLS.md encodes every mistake
Requires: Mixamo character (T-pose FBX), Blender 5.1+, Blender MCP add-on, GVHMR estimator + ~5GB checkpoints, SMPL-X body model, ~8GB VRAM GPU
